title: IBM Optim 1.0.0, 1.1.0, and 1.2.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive… (CVE-2026-17466)
description: IBM Optim versions 1.0.0, 1.1.0, and 1.2.0 contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to access sensitive information. This vulnerability has a critical severity score of 9.1 according to CVSS 3.1. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
